name: regionfill
setup: I = double(reshape(1:25, 5, 5)); m1 = false(5,5); m1(3,3) = true; m2 = false(5,5); m2(2:4, 2:4) = true; I3 = double(magic(10)); m3 = false(10,10); m3(4:7, 4:7) = true; m4 = false(10,10); m4(1:3, 5:7) = true;
comment: Sig: J = regionfill(I, MASK). Branches: single-pixel interior mask, 3x3 interior mask, larger (4x4) mask on magic(10), edge-touching mask (3-neighbour stencil at borders). MATLAB uses sparse direct (UMFPACK); numkit uses conjugate gradient at tol 1e-12, both converge to same machine-precision Laplacian solution. (I, X, Y) polygon form requires poly2mask (deferred to its own cycle). Algorithm: discrete Laplacian Dirichlet BVP (Gonzalez & Woods §3.4; NR §2.7). Image namespace 2026-05-27.
